summary: Made dataset loads and Clear Cache rebuilds much faster on network-drive installs.
details: Engine result waits now defeat the Windows network file-not-found cache and poll with a fast adaptive interval, so results appear in well under a second instead of about five seconds per engine request.
Clear Cache & Reload runs the dataset rebuild and both header refreshes concurrently instead of one after another.
The engine request wait budget is now a single server-owned setting raised from 6 to 15 seconds, preventing spurious timeouts on slower shares.
